target: monitor/scripts/audit-narrative-citations.js (git-owned, clone-push) + monitor/prompts/curmudgeon.md + monitor/prompts/tinker.md + monitor/prompts/reference/state-verification.md (all three NEVER_PUSH, operator-applied)
applied_note: All five changes applied and operator-ratified as measurement-correction (not green-washing). Script audit-narrative-citations.js -> v1.3.0: R1 widened citation acceptance (WIDE_BRACKET/PAREN/INLINE regexes + anchor head-token fallback), R2 Stage-1E repo-state filter on the review surface + SCI_REF_RE dome(?!-) fix, R3 in-document dating window (reviewed_at / filename date, default 30d, --all retained), change_5 provenance token 'window=30d filter=stage1E' in the console line. Because PROP-146 registered this script into NEVER_PUSH ~08 min before this PROP was authored, the script change was operator-applied here too (not self-pushed). Prompts: curmudgeon.md (repo-state-claim MUST-cite obligation), tinker.md (moderate+ findings cite on-disk artifact for repo/pipeline-state claims), state-verification.md Discipline 3 ('What needs a citation' shared spec). Dry-run verification: windowed 30d reading = 35.9% claim-uncited (RED, inside tinker's projected 25-40% t0 band), resolve 98.8%, bogus 1, missing 0, provenance token present; --all full-corpus = 44.7% (504 uncited) confirming the drop from 2104 is R1+R2 measurement correction, NOT windowing alone. Threshold UNCHANGED at 15%. Ramp horizon 2026-09-15; before then, PASS = downward trend on 3 consecutive cycles.
why_human_needed: This is the Stage-1 threshold policy call the directive commissioned. The recommendation changes what counts as a citable claim, what counts as a citation, and what corpus the metric measures. Operator must ratify that this is measurement correction, not green-washing; the sampled evidence is attached for exactly that check.
recommendation: MIXED (R+E). Path R for three measurement defects that are miscounting real behavior (evidence below), Path E for the genuine-uncited residue. The 15% threshold is NOT changed.

part_A_diagnosis.population: 2104 claim-uncited paragraphs (95.8% of 2196 claim-shaped) at 2026-08-02. Surface split: 2073 (98.5%) curmudgeon reviews, 31 (1.5%) tinker findings.
part_A_diagnosis.sample: 90 stratified-random flagged paragraphs (70 reviews + 20 tinker findings, seed=42, harness preserved in run report). Full-population programmatic classification corroborates the hand sample.

split.near_miss_cited: 559/2104 (26.6%) programmatic; 17/70 review sample (24%) by hand. These paragraphs DO carry file:anchor citations that the strict CITATION_RE rejects on format: cite-with-explanatory-tail '(data/wins.json:WIN-021 detail_evidence — ...)' (WIN-021.c4), dotted anchors '(data/wins.json:WIN-028.verdict)' (WIN-028.c9), multi-cite parens '(data/predictions.json:PRED-072, data/predictions.json:PRED-084)' (SEC-part6-6.15-EXP-606.c1), bracket selectors '(data/wins.json[id=012].detail_evidence)' (WIN-012.c10), inline no-paren 'data/wins.json:WIN-057 detail_evidence' (WIN-057.c3). Resolution check: 94.0% of these resolve to an existing file, 82.7% file+anchor (n=548). They are real citations, miscounted.
split.over_caught: 31/53 (58%) of the truly-uncited review-sample paragraphs are prose where a repo-file citation is boilerplate or a category error: (a) external-science argumentation whose evidence is literature, not repo files — Gaia parallax precision (KILLSHOT-GAIA), anticrepuscular-ray geometry (WIN-026.c2), MHD core dynamics w/ Terra-Nova et al. 2017 (WIN-004.c3), CERES hemispheric flux (WIN-066.c2); (b) editorial/process judgment — 'The patch was incomplete — tldr_verdict and tldr_evidence are sister fields...' (WIN-029.c5), 'N/A — this is a design EXP' (EXP-211-redesign-proposal), 'The double-bind rewrite is genuinely a stronger argument...' (SEC-8b.3.c5). Root cause: the review surface has NO claim-shape filter — every >=2-sentence paragraph is audited, unlike tinker findings (Stage 1D). The 2026-04 review-era corpus is dominated by exactly this argumentation prose.
split.genuine_uncited: 22/53 (42%) of truly-uncited review-sample paragraphs assert repo-artifact state and SHOULD cite: verdict/field assertions ('WIN-052 currently sits at verdict Misleading with finding ...' WIN-052.c3), stale-label claims ('The label still reads WIN-040-043, 059-061, 063' EXP-452-P2-P3-P4-P6.c1), patch-outcome claims ('both have been fixed in current detail_evidence' WIN-046.c3). Tinker findings: pipeline-state claims citable when an on-disk artifact exists; disk/scheduler-API observations have no file to cite (evidence field covers them).
split.window_defeat_structural: The 14-day mtime window has been dead since deployment: workspace-sync runs the audit from a fresh clone, where every file's mtime is checkout time, so ALL 1130 files pass the window every cycle. Era split by in-document dates: 2026-04: 1145 (54%), 2026-05: 547, 2026-06: 322, 2026-07: 86, 2026-08: 4. 96% of the population is >30 days old, all in append-only immutable records. The metric measures a frozen April corpus, not behavior.
split.current_behavior: Recent-30d window (in-document dates, n=91 claim-shaped): 84 uncited (92.3%) under the strict regex — BUT 48 of those 84 are near-miss cites. Current agents ARE citing (~57% of recent flagged paragraphs carry a citation), in loose formats. The convention is partially adopted; the checker can't see it.
split.minor_filter_bug: SCI_REF_RE's \bdome\b token matches every pipeline agent name (dome-social, dome-workspace-sync, dome-integrity...), so clause-c fires on pure ops narration. 7/20 sampled tinker findings were claim-shaped solely via agent names.

part_A_diagnosis.decision_input: The split is genuinely mixed: 26.6% miscounted-real-cites + ~58%-of-residue over-caught (Path R evidence) + ~42%-of-residue genuine-uncited (Path E evidence). Neither pure path resolves it.

part_B_projection.after_R2_repo_state_filter: ~17/72 = ~24% (58% sample-based over-caught removal applied to the uncited residue; removed items leave the denominator too)
part_B_projection.after_E1_E2_prompt_adoption: <=15% as newly-authored reviews/findings fill the rolling 30d window; full window turnover ~6 weeks from prompt application
part_B_projection.achievable: YES — <=15% becomes reachable honestly by ~2026-09-15, measured on the windowed metric
part_B_projection.steady_state: GREEN expected steady-state: windowed claim-uncited 5-15% (residual = late-adoption + edge prose), soft-complaint fires only on genuine regression. The metric finally measures forward behavior.

part_C_changes.change_1_script_R1_citation_re: audit-narrative-citations.js: add WIDE_CITATION_RE accepted at Stage 1 alongside strict CITATION_RE: (a) paren cite with tail: \(([./\w-]+\.(?:json|jsonl|txt|md))(?::([\w.-]+))?[^)]*\) — anchor may be dotted, tail text allowed; (b) inline no-paren: ([./\w-]+\.(?:json|jsonl|txt|md)):([\w.-]+); (c) bracket selector: file.json\[key=value\]. Stage-2 resolution of widened cites: resolve the file as today (WELL_KNOWN_PATHS applies); anchor = first [\w-]+ token of the anchor expression (dotted tails best-effort: check full dotted string first, fall back to head token). Strict-format cites remain the documented convention (PROP-146 shape rules); widened forms are ACCEPTED, not encouraged.
part_C_changes.change_2_script_R2_stage_1E_repo_state_f: New Stage 1E filter on the curmudgeon-review surface (kernel_of_truth.*, our_argument_summary): a paragraph is audited only if it asserts repo/dome-artifact state, defined as (i) mentions a tracked-file token (wins.json, sections.json, predictions.json, closed/open-issues.json, expansion-tracker.json, claim_index, monitor.py, raw-text/, dome-api-snapshots/) OR (ii) entity-id (WIN|EXP|SEC|HOL|PRED|ISS)-N + state-assertion pattern (verdict|status|finding|label|field|detail_[a-z]+|tldr_[a-z]+|says|reads|currently|now (?:sits|reads|says)|patched|fixed_at|integrated). External-science argumentation and editorial judgment paragraphs are exempt — their evidence is DOIs/literature the resolver cannot check (Stage-3 territory per the original PROP-014 design). Tinker-findings surface keeps Stage 1D and additionally exempts paragraphs whose only clause-c trigger is a dome-* agent name (fix: replace \bdome\b with \bdome\b(?!-) in SCI_REF_RE).
part_C_changes.change_3_script_R3_window: Replace the fs-mtime SINCE filter with in-document dating: reviews use reviewed_at (fallback: filename date, then mtime), tinker reports use the filename date. Default window: rolling 30 days. --all retains full-corpus behavior for ad-hoc audits. Legacy pre-window records are grandfathered per the directive's immutable_history constraint — they are append-only history that can never be retro-cited. This also cuts per-cycle audit work from 1130 files to the recent tail.
part_C_changes.change_4_prompts_E1_E2: OPERATOR-APPLIED (NEVER_PUSH): (a) curmudgeon.md review-authoring section, one paragraph: when a kernel_of_truth or our_argument_summary paragraph asserts repo-artifact state (verdicts, field contents, labels, patch outcomes), it MUST carry a strict-format inline citation (file:anchor) per state-verification.md Discipline 3 + PROP-146 shape rules; external-science reasoning cites literature normally and needs no repo cite. (b) tinker.md Output section, one line: moderate+ findings' description must cite the on-disk artifact for any repo/pipeline-state claim where one exists; shell/API observations belong in the finding's evidence field. (c) state-verification.md Discipline 3: append a short 'What needs a citation' paragraph encoding the repo-state-claim definition from change_2 so generators and checker share one spec.
part_C_changes.change_5_threshold: UNCHANGED at <=15%. Applies to the new windowed, widened, filtered metric. Soft-complaint semantics preserved (per directive constraint keep_soft_complaint_semantics). Version bump to 1.3.0; console line gains window+filter provenance ('window=30d filter=stage1E') so soft-complaint greps show the spec change explicitly.

no_green_washing_attestation: The 15% bar is untouched. Every removal from the metric is evidence-backed: R1 items demonstrably cite (559 counted, 94% file-resolve, sample-verified by hand); R2 removals are sampled non-claims with quoted examples (58% of uncited residue), and the genuine-claim residue stays IN the metric and gets prompt enforcement (Path E), not exemption; R3 grandfathering implements the directive's own immutable_history constraint and the window-defeat it fixes was a structural bug (mtime-vs-clone), not an inconvenient truth. Counter-factual: if agents stop citing tomorrow, the windowed metric goes RED within one window — the alarm still works.

ramp_and_steady_state.t0_apply_script: first reading on windowed metric expected ~25-40% (RED->YELLOW band) — honest reflection of current partial adoption
ramp_and_steady_state.t0_plus_prompt_apply: new reviews/findings emit strict-format cites on repo-state claims
ramp_and_steady_state.t_6_weeks: rolling window fully post-adoption; expect <=15% GREEN by 2026-09-15
ramp_and_steady_state.if_not_green_by_2026_09_15: residue is then real non-adoption — escalate as Path-E enforcement failure (prompt fix or agent-model issue), NOT threshold relief

verification_pattern.script: cd $CLONE && node monitor/scripts/audit-narrative-citations.js --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -oP 'claim-uncited-rate=\K[\d.]+' | awk '{ if ($1+0 <= 15) print "FIXED"; else print "STILL_BROKEN rate=" $1 }'
verification_pattern.note: Run after 2026-09-15 (ramp horizon). Before that date, PASS criterion is trend-only: windowed rate strictly below the prior reading on 3 consecutive workspace-sync audit cycles. Also verify provenance token 'window=30d' appears in the console line (proves v1.3.0 active, not a stale-FUSE reversion — see PROP-146 change_3 registration).

rollback: Script: git revert the v1.3.0 commit (single-file change, no data mutation — the audit is observational). Prompts: remove the three inserted paragraphs. The metric returns to the v1.2.0 full-corpus reading; no downstream consumer stores derived state.
tradeoffs: Windowing means the headline count drops from 2104 to double digits — optics could be mistaken for gaming. Mitigation: the run report and this PROP record the full-corpus baseline (2104 @ 2026-08-02) permanently; the console line carries the window provenance token.

Stage 1E is a judgment-encoding regex and will have residual misclassification both ways (~10-20% by sample). Acceptable for a soft-complaint metric; the sample harness is preserved for recalibration.

Widened citation acceptance slightly weakens the format norm. Mitigation: PROP-146 shape rules keep strict format as the documented convention; widened forms are grandfather-acceptance for organically-emitted cites.
estimated_impact: Perpetual-RED soft-complaint becomes a live, actionable forward-behavior metric; ~1000+ files/cycle audit-work reduction; curmudgeon/tinker citation discipline actually enforced at authorship time where it has verification value.
